name: Usage Limiter
description: Enforce token, cost, and request limits with warn/block behavior and model downgrade to control costs

limits.label: Budget Limits
limits.help: Set token, cost, and request limits per time period. Only configured limits are enforced.

warnThreshold.label: Warning Threshold
warnThreshold.help: Fraction of budget at which warnings appear (default: 0.8 = 80%)

blockThreshold.label: Block Threshold
blockThreshold.help: Fraction of budget at which requests are blocked (default: 1.0 = 100%)

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: IANA timezone for period boundaries (e.g., America/New_York)

fallbackModel.label: Fallback Model
fallbackModel.help: Cheaper model to suggest/use when approaching limits (e.g., anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5)

autoDowngrade.label: Auto Downgrade
autoDowngrade.help: Automatically instruct the agent to use the fallback model at the warn threshold

tokens.label: Token Limit
tokens.help: Maximum total tokens for this period

cost.label: Cost Limit (USD)
cost.help: Maximum cost in dollars for this period

requests.label: Request Limit
requests.help: Maximum number of LLM requests for this period
